api_tracking.title: Set up USPS API Tracking
api_tracking.description: Enter the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret for your USPS app with Tracking enabled.

informed_delivery.title: Set up USPS Informed Delivery
informed_delivery.description: Sign in with the USPS account enrolled in Informed Delivery. Reauthentication may require an MFA code.

informed_delivery_challenge.title: Verify your USPS sign-in
informed_delivery_challenge.description:
USPS needs one more step to finish signing in. USPS says:

{prompt}

reauth_confirm.title: USPS credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: USPS no longer accepts the stored Consumer Key/Secret — it may have been rotated or revoked. Enter a new one.

error.tracking_not_enabled: These credentials do not have the USPS Tracking product enabled.
error.not_enrolled: No address on this USPS account is enrolled in Informed Delivery.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach USPS. Please try again.
error.too_many_challenges: USPS asked for too many verification steps in a row. Please try signing in again.
error.invalid_code: USPS did not accept that verification code. Sign in again to receive a new one.
error.push_approval_timeout: USPS is waiting for you to approve this sign-in on your phone, but it timed out. Please try again and approve the prompt promptly.

data_description.add: Enter an USPS tracking code to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like an USPS tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its USPS tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its USPS tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The USPS tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
